name: two_regions_enclosed
description: (i) Stokes, Laplacian form, in both regions of split_rect: no-slip on hot and cold, the lid 4 U x (L - x) / L^2 on the top and no-slip on the bottom (both are the remaining attributes, so the lid is a function of position); compared with the same mesh given one element attribute (fluids.Mesh.from_arrays of the bridge mesh's arrays and nodes)
mesh: the mesher's unstructured mesh of the document (gmsh, bounded planar mode, algorithm and options of axmp-mesher), mesh.size = H/8, region a H/16, geometry order 2 (the default: straight edges, with nodes); one process

p_one_attribute.what: max |p - p_one| / max |p| at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element (zero-mean pressures)

any other partition the gate is pointed at
